name: constraint-scope
body: `attaches-to` is not part of the model. `rust.apg.layers.write.validate_change` refuses any `attaches-to` on a new constraint, and any added or changed `attaches-to` value whatever its target; an unchanged existing `attaches-to` value passes, so existing constraints stay authorable. `rust.apg.layers.validate.eval_constraint` is the shared structural check (name, layer/type, uniqueness) that both the write path and the scan path call. The scan path `rust.apg.layers.tree.ingest_tree` loads existing constraints carrying an `attaches-to`, and `apg spec lint` reports them.
